proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free API requests per day (refreshed daily, no credit card required).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides reliable, fast serverless API access to FLUX.1-schnell, SDXL, and specialized ControlNet models. Does not block GitHub Actions runner IPs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Direct replacement for Pollinations inside 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines via simple Python requests.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Daily limit is strictly enforced; requires robust error-handling when credits are exhausted.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any web URL into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown. Bypasses typical scraper blocks (Cloudflare) and works instantly within lightweight Python scripts on GitHub Actions without needing heavy headless browsers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used by 'agent_trendhunter' and 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to scrape e-commerce trend blogs and marketplace search results for niche extraction.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Highly dynamic SPA sites (Single Page Applications) might occasionally return empty layouts if they require complex JS execution.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous initial free credit trial ($10-$15 signup credit) with ultra-low pricing thereafter (FLUX.1-schnell costs ~$0.003 per image).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: High-performance open-source model hosting with zero rate limits on free trial credits. Extremely fast inference times for FLUX and SD3.
proposals.would_integrate_where: High-quality image generation fallback when Together AI or Cloudflare Workers AI limits are hit during peak coloring book generation runs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires a credit card to unlock the API key, although the free credits are consumed first.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to list digital STL/3D files. Low transaction fee on sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Prusa's official 3D printing repository now has a dedicated digital store. It receives massive organic, highly targeted traffic of 3D printer owners looking for premium models, bypassing Cults3D saturation.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target marketplace for 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline outputs (e.g., customized functional prints, gears, organizer bins).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Users expect high-quality printable files; models must be sliced and verified for printability.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly subscription fees. Flat transaction fee of 5% + 50c per sale.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as the Merchant of Record (MoR). They handle global sales tax and EU VAT compliance automatically, which is an absolute necessity for a solo entrepreneur based in France selling digital goods.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Direct storefront for digital PDF coloring books, SVG packs, and gamedev assets generated by the pipelines, hosted on a free GitHub Pages site.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payout thresholds apply, and digital products must not violate their strict acceptable use policy regarding low-effort AI spam.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to host, share, and promote assets.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The largest repository for free indie gamedev assets. Excellent for 'freemium' marketing: releasing a free base pack (CC-BY) to drive highly targeted organic traffic to paid expansion packs hosted on Lemon Squeezy.
proposals.would_integrate_where: The traffic generation phase of the 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' pipeline.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Must strictly follow licensing standards (CC-BY, CC0) to build developer trust.
